name: Veekayem Fashion & Apparels Ltd.
summary: Veekayem Fashion & Apparels Ltd. is an India-based company operating within the textile and garment industry. The company is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a diverse range of fabrics and readymade garments. Its business operations encompass weaving, processing, dyeing, printing, finishing, and garment manufacturing. The company produces various textile products, including grey cloths, 100% cotton variants such as Lycra, Non-Lycra, Giza, and Supima, as well as blended cotton suiting materials like chief value cotton, polyester cotton, terry rayon suiting, and mock linen. It also deals in synthetic textiles, yarn products, home furnishings, and other wearable and non-wearable textiles. In terms of garments, Veekayem Fashion & Apparels Ltd. manufactures a wide array of men's, women's, and kids' wear, including formal and cotton shirts, various trousers, joggers, shorts, pajamas, denims, business and party wear suits, t-shirts, woolen jackets, pullovers, and skirts. The company follows a business-to-business (B2B) model, supplying its fabrics and finished garments to various retail brands and wholesalers. It also caters to domestic and international markets through exports, offering customized designs to clients and customers within the textile and apparel industry. The company has recently expanded its reach by incorporating a wholly-owned subsidiary, Veekayem Retail Private Limited, to engage in the business of garments, fashion accessories, and lifestyle products, including both leather and non-leather items for men and women.
